correctness.rationale: Theorem 2.3(c) of arXiv:2403.07387v1 gives the full support inequalities for positive integer b and n>=2. Every admissible inball has c_i>=1+r; averaging every k-subset upper inequality gives r<=(U_k-k)/(k+sqrt(k)). The constant center 1+min_k R_k attains all inequalities. Equality for one minimizing k forces all c_i, and exact Euclidean distances establish the tangent-facet classification, including exclusion of redundant k=n-1 when b1=1. For realizability, auxiliary b=(1+u,0,...,0,B) yield R_j=(ju+B)/(j+sqrt j); consecutive switching ratios T_j are strictly increasing. Rational choices between thresholds, positive perturbations and integral scaling produce every unique active cardinality. This covers n=2 and k=1,n; high-precision/finite checks are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: A complete Euclidean inball and facet-contact classification for a motivated infinite family of positive-parameter parking-function polytopes is a natural metric invariant. Exact realizability of every cardinality k, particularly 1<k<n, identifies genuine structural phases absent from the previously studied restricted two-parameter geometry. This is more than a numerical/renaming exercise: it includes a constructive all-dimensional phase-surjectivity theorem, a unique optimal center, and an exact tangent-facet count. Further applications and general-norm extensions remain open.
